title: Protocol outline
body_text:
The protocol will last about 20 minutes and is organized as follows.


First, you will must perform a task that will be used to verify that you understand the instructions. This task will contribute to your bonus remuneration (you will earn £0.045 for each correct answer). It will be the only task of the introduction that does contribute to the bonus remuneration.

To finalize the training, you will then start the preparation phase, which consists in solving a task which will closely resemble those of the main experimental phase.

Then, the main experiment will start. It will be divided into 2 sessions. Each session consists in solving 2 tasks of 13 questions each, that will count towards your score and bonus remuneration. After each task, you will have to take a survey to give feedback about the task.

Finally, you will enter the closing phase, in which you will have to answer a final survey to conclude the protocol.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below.
